name: Quincy Jones
hook: A jazz trumpeter and arranger who became the producer behind the best-selling album ever made.
blurb: Jones began his career as a jazz trumpeter and arranger for big bands in the early 1950s before moving into film scoring and pop production. He produced Michael Jackson's 'Off the Wall' (1979) and 'Thriller' (1982), the best-selling album in history, bringing a jazz arranger's ear for horns and rhythm to mainstream pop. That path, from big-band jazz to the best-selling album ever, is the clearest jazz-to-pop crossing on this map, which makes his work on Jackson's records a real connection between lineages rather than a credit inside one genre.

signatureTracks.title: Off the Wall (produced for Michael Jackson)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: Their first collaboration, and the record where Jackson's adult solo sound first took shape.

signatureTracks.title: Thriller (produced for Michael Jackson)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: The best-selling album ever made, and the clearest large-scale demonstration of Jones's pop production.
